//! Checkout payment handling.

// @flow checkout.pay: charge first, create the order after
/// Charges the card.
#[spec("checkout.paid")]
pub fn pay(cart: &Cart) -> Result<Receipt, PayError> {
    /// @flow checkout.failed: cap retries, then cancel
    charge(cart)
}

#[spec("checkout.failed", "checkout.refunded/r2")]
pub fn fail(cart: &Cart) {}
